end.summary: Practised explaining unity in diversity using the flower-garland analogy; this still needs checking next time.
end.parentNote: Riya practised the idea that different languages, foods and traditions can be joined by shared values, using a flower garland as an example. They identified Pongal and Lohri as different forms of harvest celebrations, but continued to suggest that everyone should eat the same food to share together; this was not corrected by the last response. At home, ask Riya to name two different foods or festivals and one shared value that connects them.
